about: I own Microsoft 365 platforms end to end: architecture, development, security and governance. As AI writes more code, the scarce skill isn't producing solutions — it's auditing permissions, hardening tenants and catching what generated code gets wrong. That's where I spend most of my attention.

I started at an IT services firm in December 2021 as a trainee, then spent two years as a software engineer delivering 20+ applications across six concurrent client engagements in the US, UK and Canada. I led an organisation-wide Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migration, built a C# tenant-to-tenant migration platform, and led a security audit for a Canadian client after a live incident.

After a short stint as a SharePoint developer, I joined a Big Four global delivery centre, where I led a Risk Management module that used Microsoft Copilot for AI-assisted release analysis and approvals, and built 10+ Power Apps with 50+ workflows.

Since October 2025 I've been the sole owner of SharePoint, Microsoft 365 and the Power Platform across a five-company industrial group in the GCC. In twelve months I delivered seven production systems across six business functions, approved at Chief Officer and Director level — including a contract platform that turned days of work into minutes.
I also build bilingual Arabic/English enterprise applications with right-to-left document generation.
